orgs.name: Sabor Bajero (Familias Emprendedoras programme, Alianza Team + Alcaldía de Barranquilla)
orgs.members_estimate: 50 women street-food cooks (OECD Local Development Forum 2025 partner page); 13 editions held
orgs.notes: Recurring street food festival of Barrio Abajo cooks, run by the company Alianza Team with the Mayor's Office. The festival has no site or email of its own, so the Instagram link is the organiser company's account (it also has LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/alianzateam).

orgs.name: IPES - Instituto para la Economía Social (Bogotá; runs Fritanga Fest and the street vendor programmes)

emails.reason: Published on the IPES homepage as the address for filing correspondence; ipes.gov.co has Google MX records.

orgs.members_estimate: 55-70 establishments per Fritanga Fest edition (bogota.gov.co, 2025); also keeps the city's informal street vendor register (RIVI)
orgs.notes: A public agency, not a trade body. It organises the 7th Fritanga Fest (2-4 Oct 2026) and the fairs and commercial points for informal street vendors. Worth approaching as a channel to street food traders, but expect public-sector procedures.

orgs.name: Asamblea / Asociación Colombiana de Food Trucks
orgs.notes: Mentioned only in 2014-era coverage (it was not yet legally formed then), with chef Mariano Moreno named as its head in a Uniandes piece. No current site or social account found; it may have merged into Aso Food Trucks Bogotá (already known). No contact route was found, so the channel is nominal.

orgs.name: Gremio de food trucks de Medellín (Ciudad del Río / La Floresta)
orgs.members_estimate: about 15 trucks on Avenida 80 (Accounter / El Colombiano, Sept 2014)
orgs.notes: An informal guild led by Juan David Piedrahíta Gil (Biofrut) that lobbied for regulation; the only later trace is a 2018 El Colombiano piece on the Ciudad del Río dispute. No name, site or social account found, so the channel is nominal.

orgs.name: Gastropark Cali (Ferias y Eventos S.A., with Acodrés and Comfandi)
orgs.members_estimate: 130 brands including a food truck village (El Tiempo, July 2021)
orgs.notes: A one-off 2021 post-COVID food park with a food truck area. No later editions were found. No contact route was found, so the channel is nominal.
